_about: The Line of the Day: one verbatim line a day from a filing, letter, hearing, ruling or incident report, the most telling words on the record that day. Copied exactly from a page opened that run (mark cuts with …), attributed to who said or wrote it, with the source. Checked twice like everything else. Newest first; the homepage shows the newest one dated on or before the edition.
